common_contract.entry: Production contracts cannot execute until G00-G14 evidence/readiness is accepted independently and control.build_authorized is true. P0 remains quarantined.
common_contract.identity: Base commit + dirty source SHA256 before build; compiler/SDK/package hashes; build artifact SHA256; exact argv/cwd/exits; pre-merge and merged identities kept distinct.
common_contract.ownership: Codex builder; Claude independent QA; separate Gatekeeper review. QA cannot repair application source.
qa_evidence: post-merge regression when a checkpoint is merged
common_contract.closure: No full checkpoint closes without all required platform evidence, independent acceptance, integration identity and merged regression. Human device outcomes cannot be synthesized.
common_contract.rollback: Retain preceding checkpoint commit and authoritative local boards; revert source integration by a new revert commit only after identifying data/external-effect reversal. Never reset/clean a dirty checkout.
common_contract.repository: Only https://github.com/lionellmisquitta/unruly.git; personal preparation/prototype branch allowed; no organizational GitLab; preview/offline-canvas is optional discussion only.
